title: Solitary Man NEIL DIAMOND
lyrics_plain:
Melinda was mine
Till the time
That I found her
Holding Jim,
Loving him.
Then Sue came along,
Loved me strong
That's what I thought,
Me and Sue,
But that died too.
Don't know that I will,
But until I can find me
The girl who'll stay
And won't play games behind me,
I'll be what I am
A Solitary Man,
Solitary Man.
I've had it to here
Bein' where love's
A small word,
Part time thing,
Paper ring.
I know it's been done,
Havin' one
Girl who'll love me,
Right or wrong,
Weak or strong.
Don't know that I will,
But until I can find me
The girl who'll stay
And won't play games behind me,
I'll be what I am
A Solitary Man,
Solitary Man.
Don't know that I will,
But until I can find me
The girl who'll stay
And won't play games behind me,
I'll be what I am
A Solitary Man,
Solitary Man.
